input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (with indemnification and confidentiality carved out). There is no monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement — searches for "aggregate liability" and "exceed" return nothing, and no cap is hidden in the warranty (para 9) or indemnity (paras 47-55) provisions. Both parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, leaving Customer's exposure uncapped contrary to the playbook requirement for a meaningful mutual cap. Because the commercial model is revenue share rather than Customer-paid fees, a pure fees-based cap would be illusory, so the cap is drafted as the greater of twelve months' amounts under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement uncapped and payment obligations preserved.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 excludes indirect damages but contains no monetary cap, so both parties' direct liability is unlimited; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' amounts under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000. Indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, as do amounts due for payment; we can fall back to a straight twelve-month cap with those same carve-outs.

ops.text: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The foregoing limitation does not limit either Party's obligation to pay amounts due under this Agreement.
